table.name: ref_shipping_agents
table.summary: A reference table containing master data for various shipping agents, including their unique codes, names, and brief descriptions.

shipping_agent_code.name: shipping_agent_code
shipping_agent_code.meaning: A unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to a specific shipping agent.

shipping_agent_name.name: shipping_agent_name
shipping_agent_name.meaning: The official or common name of the shipping agent organization.

shipping_agent_description.name: shipping_agent_description
shipping_agent_description.meaning: A short textual note or code describing the shipping agent, potentially indicating service type or region.

table.name: document_drafts
table.summary: Stores metadata and unique identifiers for document drafts, likely used to track versioning or specific draft states within a document management system.

document_id.name: document_id
document_id.meaning: A unique identifier for the parent document associated with the draft.

draft_number.name: draft_number
draft_number.meaning: A sequential or unique integer representing the specific draft instance or version number.

draft_details.name: draft_details
draft_details.meaning: A short code or status indicator representing the current state or type of the draft.

table.name: circulation_history
table.summary: Records tracking the circulation instances of specific documents, including draft and copy numbers, associated with specific employees.

document_id.name: document_id
document_id.meaning: Unique identifier for the document being circulated.

draft_number.name: draft_number
draft_number.meaning: Sequence number indicating which draft version of the document is being circulated.

copy_number.name: copy_number
copy_number.meaning: Sequence number indicating which copy of the document is being circulated.

employee_id.name: employee_id
employee_id.meaning: Identifier of the employee involved in the circulation process (e.g., creator, approver, or recipient).

table.name: ref_document_status
table.summary: A reference table defining the possible states and descriptions of documents within the system.

document_status_code.name: document_status_code
document_status_code.meaning: A unique alphanumeric identifier representing the current state of a document.

document_status_description.name: document_status_description
document_status_description.meaning: A human-readable text string explaining the meaning of the status code.

table.name: ref_document_types
table.summary: A reference table defining standard document types with their unique codes and descriptions.

document_type_code.name: document_type_code
document_type_code.meaning: A unique alphanumeric identifier for a specific document type.

document_type_description.name: document_type_description
document_type_description.meaning: A textual description or label for the document type, though sample values suggest it may currently store short codes or single characters.

table.name: addresses
table.summary: Stores unique address identifiers and their corresponding country codes.

address_id.name: address_id
address_id.meaning: A unique numeric identifier for each address record.

address_details.name: address_details
address_details.meaning: The ISO country code representing the country associated with the address.

table.name: draft_copies
table.summary: Stores individual copies or versions of documents, identified by a parent document and a specific draft/copy sequence number.

document_id.name: document_id
document_id.meaning: Unique identifier for the parent document to which this copy belongs.

draft_number.name: draft_number
draft_number.meaning: Sequence number representing the specific draft iteration of the document.

copy_number.name: copy_number
copy_number.meaning: Sequence number representing the specific copy instance within a draft.
